verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents an official, free Web Clipper browser extension that highlights pages and saves web content directly to the vault, which matches the story's official browser-to-notes capture flow. The support rests on a single short doc statement, with nothing on how it handles articles or how highlights are formatted in notes. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of article extraction and how highlights land in notes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the clipper.
